title: OpenAI and Government of Malta partner to roll out ChatGPT Plus to all citizens
summary: OpenAI has partnered with the Government of Malta to provide free ChatGPT Plus subscriptions to all Maltese citizens, making Malta the first country to offer universal access to OpenAI's premium AI tools. This initiative aims to enhance digital literacy and ensure equitable access to advanced AI technology across the entire population.
problem_solved: Democratizes access to advanced AI tools by providing free ChatGPT Plus to all citizens regardless of economic background.
why_valuable: Sets a precedent for government-tech partnerships in making AI technology universally accessible, potentially bridging digital divides and boosting national productivity.
